title: Is there a good way to get feedback on a game i've made?
author: EvidenceSevere1877
selftext:
I’m a concept artist who’s been in the game industry for over 10 years. 

I don’t know how to code, and I only have a basic understanding of 3D. As the industry shifts, I know many artists are hesitant or against using AI tools. 

I completely understand where they’re coming from, but I’ve always been open to AI once it became genuinely useful for my workflow. 

Lately, I noticed games being built through 'vibe coding' and AI generated assets. While they aren't perfect, the results were surprisingly solid. 

That made me realize: it’s time to try building my own game project using these tools. 

Since creating art is what I love most, I drew and modeled the core assets myself because that’s the most enjoyable part for me. 

But I used AI assistance for coding and base modeling to bridge the gap. 

this’s my very first AI assisted solo project! 



I know there’s still plenty to polish, but the process was insanely fun and a massive learning experience. I also plan to keep updating and expanding this build, so please feel free to leave any feedback or comments. it means a lot!  
[https://fufuhol.itch.io/boo-boys](https://fufuhol.itch.io/boo-boys)

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: We are currently running a beta where users can submit bug reports/feedback from within the game. Its been very useful! [https://www.reddit.com/r/LittleLinksGolf/](https://www.reddit.com/r/LittleLinksGolf/)

comments.author: MinimumEffort-Games
comments.body: It's hard to get feedback on anything, since everything is flooded. Even if you would put it on steam with request access and get people involved in the dev process, its still hard. I see many games come by here that look pretty interesting, but they barely get upvoted or comments. So i have no advice.
